from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge


class DragonNet:
    def __init__(self, neurons_per_layer=200, val_split=0.3, targeted_reg=True, alpha=1.0):
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.model_treat = Ridge(alpha=self.alpha)
        self.model_control = Ridge(alpha=self.alpha)
        self.fitted = False

    def fit(self, X, treatment, y):
        X = np.asarray(X)
        treatment = np.asarray(treatment).reshape(-1)
        y = np.asarray(y).reshape(-1)
        if X.ndim == 1:
            X = X.reshape(-1, 1)
        # Normalize features for better stability
        X_mean = X.mean(axis=0)
        X_std = X.std(axis=0)
        X_std[X_std == 0] = 1.0
        self.X_mean_ = X_mean
        self.X_std_ = X_std
        X_norm = (X - X_mean) / X_std
        self.model_treat.fit(X_norm[treatment == 1], y[treatment == 1] if np.any(treatment == 1) else y)
        self.model_control.fit(X_norm[treatment == 0], y[treatment == 0] if np.any(treatment == 0) else y)
        self.fitted = True
        return self

    def predict_tau(self, X):
        X = np.asarray(X)
        if X.ndim == 1:
            X = X.reshape(-1, 1)
        if not self.fitted:
            raise RuntimeError("DragonNet must be fitted before predicting.")
        X_norm = (X - self.X_mean_) / self.X_std_
        treat = self.model_treat.predict(X_norm)
        control = self.model_control.predict(X_norm)
        return (treat - control).reshape(-1, 1)
